title: Physical and cognitive symptoms of grief
content: Grief isn't purely emotional, it commonly comes with physical symptoms like fatigue, appetite changes, or a heavy feeling in the chest, and cognitive effects like trouble concentrating, forgetfulness, or feeling foggy. These are normal parts of how the body and mind process a major loss, not separate problems.
